title: Knot extension manifest
description: knot.jsonc accepts JSON comments and trailing commas before schema validation.

apiVersion.description: Required Knot public API version, independent of the package version.

main.description: A relative .js or .mjs file path inside the package; empty, dot, parent, and backslash segments are invalid.

contract.description: A relative .js or .mjs file path inside the package, other than main, to the module that defines the contracts other packages import. It may import only "knot/contract" and its own relative modules.

requires.description: Packages that must load first. A package may import the contract of a package it requires.

entitlements.description: Capabilities the package needs. Knot asks the user before loading a package whose entitlements are undecided, and does not load one whose entitlement was denied.
